conventions.biases: both biases are exactly zero, frozen and stored at every checkpoint
conventions.crossing: the same five shuffle schedules apply to all initialization IDs and datasets; order generation never uses init_seed
conventions.design: 3 datasets x 10 stored initializations x 5 crossed shuffle schedules; 150 runs
conventions.evaluation: official test split, sequential batches, mean cross entropy and classification accuracy
conventions.half_epoch: ceil(235/2)=118 updates; 21 checkpoints including E0 and E20
conventions.initialization: construct original architecture with init_seed; assert bitwise equality to stored original E0; load that E0
conventions.ordering: dataset order mnist,fashion_mnist,kmnist; then numeric init_id; then numeric shuffle_id
conventions.precision: CPU float32 weights/momentum/training, float64 test-summary arrays
conventions.resume: atomic .progress.pt after each checkpoint; restore weights, optimizer, all RNGs, epoch order and position

factor_order: dataset order mnist,fashion_mnist,kmnist; then numeric init_id; then numeric shuffle_id
